att_secure.definition: Describing a person who takes the partner's availability for granted and stays steady when it wobbles.
att_secure.example: She is secure with him, so she says she is upset instead of guessing.

dpn_batna.definition: The best deal you can make if the deal in front of you does not happen.
dpn_batna.example: Before the meeting he wrote down his BATNA: the other supplier, the price and the date.

hazard_lights.definition: All four indicators blink together. The car is stationary or unusual. Severity level 1 — Information / Status. Action: Nothing to do while the lights are on. Switch them off once the car moves again..
